label: H.R. 8580
title: Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2025

items.snippet: This bill provides FY2025 appropriations for military construction, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), and related agencies.
The bill provides appropriations to the Department of Defense (DOD) for military construction for the Army;
The bill provides appropriations to the Department of Defense (DOD) for military construction for the Army;
the Army and Air National Guard;
and the Army, Navy, and Air Force Reserves.

The bill also provides appropriations to DOD for the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) Security Investment Program;

items.item: Construction and Operation and Maintenance of Family Housing for the Army
items.snippet: Construction and Operation and Maintenance of Family Housing for the Army, the Navy and Marine Corps, the Air Force, and Defense-wide agencies and activities;
and the Military Unaccompanied Housing Improvement Fund.

C001051.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
C001051.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
